最多导入 100 个 API，请拆分文件。: Import up to 100 APIs at a time. Split larger files.
本次发布不会自动更新已有 Agent，请在 Agent 管理中重新发布。: Existing Agents are not updated automatically. Republish them in Agent management.
还没有 API，添加第一个查询接口。: No APIs yet. Add your first query endpoint.
服务地址不在服务器允许的主机列表中，请检查地址或联系管理员。: The service host is not allowed. Check the address or contact your administrator.
配置已修改或归档，请刷新后重试。: The configuration has changed or been archived. Refresh and try again.
配置已修改或停用，请刷新并检查启用状态。: The configuration has changed or is disabled. Refresh and check its status.
工具配置无效，请检查地址、请求头和参数格式。: Invalid tool configuration. Check the URL, headers and parameter format.
调用标识已存在，请使用其他标识。: This API identifier already exists. Choose another identifier.
已有发布历史，请使用归档保留历史记录。: This item has published versions. Archive it to preserve its history.
仍有 Agent 引用，请先移除引用。: Agents still reference this item. Remove those references first.
存在重复接口路径，请调整后再导出 OpenAPI。: Duplicate API paths exist. Resolve them before exporting OpenAPI.
OpenAPI 文档无效或超出解析限制，请检查文件。: Invalid OpenAPI document or parsing limits exceeded. Check the file.
API 使用相对路径；服务地址支持 HTTP 和 HTTPS。: APIs use relative paths. Service addresses support HTTP and HTTPS.
参数将作为 JSON 请求体发送；支持对象和数组，复杂结构请使用 JSON Sc: Parameters are sent as a JSON body. Objects and arrays are supported; use JSON Schema for complex structures.
只导入选中的 GET / POST 接口，不导入密钥，不自动发布。: Import selected GET / POST APIs as drafts, without credentials or automatic publication.
将携带已保存的鉴权，向当前接口发送真实 {{method}} 请求。: Send a real {{method}} request to this API using the saved credentials.
我确认发送此 POST 请求，接口可能修改业务数据。: I confirm sending this POST request, which may modify business data.
将 Agent 接入企业业务系统，独立管理授权、密钥与调用记录。: Connect Agents to enterprise systems with independent permissions, keys and request logs.
仅可授权已发布的 Agent，调用时使用当前发布版本。: Only published Agents can be authorized. Calls use the currently published version.
密钥仅在创建时展示一次，请妥善保存。: Keys are shown only once when created. Save them securely.
密钥只授权当前应用，不具备后台管理权限。轮换时可设置旧密钥的过渡有效期。: Keys authorize this application without administrative access. Rotation supports an overlap period.
使用此密钥的后续请求将被拒绝。: Subsequent requests using this key will be rejected.
关闭后无法再次查看完整密钥。: The full key cannot be viewed again after closing.
响应耗时统计到响应头生成；SSE 的完整执行耗时请查看运行耗时。日志不记录密钥和: Response latency ends when headers are produced. See run duration for SSE execution time. Logs omit keys and request bodies.
创建第一个应用，开始企业集成。: Create your first application to start integration.
三步接入：授权 Agent → 创建密钥 → 从企业服务端调用。: Three steps: authorize an Agent → create a key → call from your enterprise server.
外部用户标识由企业服务端在完成用户认证后传入；不要将应用密钥嵌入公开网页或移动端: Your enterprise server supplies the external user ID after authenticating the user. Do not embed application keys in public web or mobile clients.
会话按应用和外部用户隔离。同一外部会话标识可安全重试创建；发送消息必须携带唯一的: Conversations are isolated by application and external user. Session creation is idempotent. Each message needs a unique Idempotency-Key; reuse it for retries of that message.
SSE 返回运行进度事件，并在 run.completed 中返回完整回答；当前: SSE emits progress and a complete answer in run.completed, not token deltas. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID.
普通调用最多等待 30 秒，未完成时返回 HTTP 202 和运行 ID。关闭事: Normal calls wait up to 30 seconds, then return HTTP 202 and a run ID if unfinished. Closing a stream does not cancel a run; call the cancel endpoint.
所有公开接口共享应用请求配额，轮询也计入；超限返回 429 和 Retry-Af: All public endpoints share the application quota, including polls. Limits return 429 and Retry-After. Concurrency includes queued and running tasks.
401 密钥无效或过期；403 应用停用或未授权；404 资源不可见；409 会: 401 invalid/expired key; 403 disabled/unauthorized; 404 inaccessible; 409 busy/idempotency conflict; 422 invalid input; 429 rate limited; 503 unavailable.
使用真实应用密钥调试，调用会计入配额并生成日志。: Debug with a real application key. Calls consume quota and generate logs.
密钥仅保留在当前页面内存中，离开页面后清除。: Keys are held in this page's memory and cleared when you leave.
固定版本后，新运行使用指定版本；已开始的运行保持原版本。: New runs use the pinned version. Existing runs keep their original snapshot.
授权后允许应用同步文档并发布整个知识库。: Grants document synchronization and publication of the entire library.
同步文本或 Markdown 先生成草稿，显式发布后进入检索；索引状态可通过任务: Text or Markdown is staged as a draft. Publish explicitly to make it searchable; check indexing via the task API.
SDK 用于企业服务端，提供会话、事件流、知识同步与 Webhook 验签。: Server-side SDKs provide conversations, event streams, knowledge synchronization and webhook verification.
接收运行结束与知识发布结果，失败自动重试，最多 5 次。: Receive run and knowledge publication outcomes; failed deliveries retry up to 5 attempts.
修改回调配置会取消旧配置的待投递事件；在途请求可能已发送。接收端需按 event: Configuration changes cancel pending old deliveries. In-flight requests may already be sent. Deduplicate by event_id.
签名采用 HMAC-SHA256，验签原文为时间戳、英文句点和原始请求体。请使用: HMAC-SHA256 signs timestamp + period + raw body. Use SDK verification with a bounded time window.
仅可授权已发布的 Agent，可在集成配置中固定版本。: Authorize published Agents; pin versions in integration settings.
应用只能管理自己同步的文档。更新和删除需携带 expected_version；: Applications manage only their own synced documents. Updates/deletes require expected_version; publication requires Idempotency-Key.
尚未配置可用的对话模型: No chat model is configured yet
平台可以先启动。请添加供应商连接和 Chat 模型，发布配置方案后绑定到 Age: You can start the platform now. Add a provider connection and a Chat model, publish a profile and bind it to an Agent to start chatting.
接收客服消息，映射客户会话，并拉取 Agent 与人工回复。: Receive customer messages, map conversations, and retrieve Agent and human replies.
自研网站、App 和企业系统调用 Agent，请使用“应用接入”。需要接入客服消: Use Application integration to call Agents from your website, app, or business system. Use the generic messaging protocol for customer service messages and human replies. Native WeCom and Feishu adapters are not yet available.
AI 回答仅供参考，请核实重要信息。: AI answers are for reference. Verify important information.
不同来源的账号不会按姓名或邮箱自动合并。: Accounts from different providers are never merged by name or email.
不要将应用密钥放入网页。无 SSO 时，由企业服务端调用 /openapi/v1: Keep app keys on your server. Without SSO, get user credentials via /openapi/v1/chat/token.
仅管理员可管理企业身份: Only administrators can manage enterprise identities
使用企业账号登录，继续你的专属会话。: Sign in with your enterprise account to start chatting.
修改配置会使已有登录会话失效。嵌入聊天需要在应用中单独授权身份提供方。: Changes revoke existing sessions. Authorize chat login providers separately for each app.
创建后复制回调地址到企业身份平台。企业微信使用自建应用；钉钉需开通用户信息和 u: Register the callback URL after creating a provider. Use a WeCom internal app; grant DingTalk profile and unionId-to-user permissions; enter your Feishu Tenant Key. OIDC requires authorization code and PKCE S256.
填写完整来源，包含协议和端口，不支持通配符，例如 https://oa.comp: Enter exact origins including scheme and port, e.g. https://oa.company.com. No wildcards.
填写用户访问平台的完整来源地址，例如 https://agent.company: Enter the platform origin, e.g. https://agent.company.com, without a path.
将聊天助手嵌入企业网站，使用 SSO 或用户级短期凭据登录。: Embed chat with SSO or short-lived user credentials.
已加密保存；留空保留原密钥。: Encrypted at rest. Leave blank to keep the current secret.
此身份下次登录将获得目标用户的权限。双方当前会话会被撤销。: On next login this identity gets the target user's permissions. Both users' sessions will be revoked.
用于校验企业归属，企业标识变更时请新建身份提供方。: Used to verify enterprise membership. Create a new provider when the organization changes.
登录服务地址与当前平台地址不一致: The login origin does not match this platform
直接输入密钥，服务端加密保存。: Enter your secret directly. It is encrypted on the server.
确认变更身份归属？: Change the owner of this identity?
确认属于同一人后，可将身份关联到目标用户 ID；旧会话会被撤销，历史聊天不会迁移: Verify both identities belong to the same person before linking. Sessions are revoked; past chats are not migrated.
管理员可在开放平台中配置企业登录。: Administrators can configure enterprise login in Open Platform.
统一接入企业登录，管理账号映射与工作台权限。: Connect enterprise sign-in and manage account mappings and workbench access.
获取登录凭据失败，请重试: Could not get login credentials. Please retry.
请允许浏览器打开登录窗口: Allow the browser to open the login window
请通过企业页面中的嵌入组件打开聊天: Open chat through the widget on your enterprise page
身份已登记，请联系管理员分配工作台角色: Identity registered. Ask an administrator for a workbench role.
运行仍在处理中，请稍后重新打开会话: Still processing. Please revisit this conversation later.
配置变更会使已有聊天凭据失效，用户需要重新登录。: Configuration changes revoke chat credentials. Users must sign in again.
首次登录只登记身份，工作台角色由管理员分配。: First login registers identity only. Administrators assign workbench roles.
连接企业知识、业务工具与服务团队: Connect enterprise knowledge, tools and service teams
登录你的企业智能服务平台: Sign in to your enterprise service platform
本地管理员可在企业登录不可用时使用: Local administrator access remains available when enterprise login is unavailable.
本地管理员尚未初始化，请联系部署管理员完成设置。: The local administrator has not been set up. Contact your deployment administrator.
暂未配置企业登录，请使用账号登录: Enterprise login is not configured. Use account login.
尝试次数过多，请在 15 分钟后重试: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
新密码不能与原密码相同: The new password must differ from the current password
登录服务暂不可用，请稍后重试: The sign-in service is unavailable. Please try again.
登录已过期，请重新登录: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
退出后需要重新登录，未保存的修改将丢失。: You will need to sign in again. Unsaved changes will be lost.
修改密码后，所有本地登录会话将失效。: Changing your password signs out all local sessions.
设置专属密码后即可进入工作台。: Set your own password to access the workspace.
修改密码并重新登录: Change password and sign in again
